WITH stock AS (SELECT exi_art, SUM(exi_qty) AS stock_total FROM exidet GROUP BY exi_art),
venta AS (SELECT vta_art, SUM(vta_und) / 30.0 AS vdp FROM vtadia WHERE vta_fch > DATE '2026-09-26' - 30 AND vta_fch <= DATE '2026-09-26' GROUP BY vta_art)
SELECT a.art_cd, COALESCE(s.stock_total,0) AS stock, v.vdp, COALESCE(s.stock_total,0)/v.vdp AS cobertura, p.prv_dte, a.art_ptr
FROM artmst a
JOIN prvmst p ON p.prv_id = a.art_prv
JOIN venta v ON v.vta_art = a.art_cd AND v.vdp > 0
LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.exi_art = a.art_cd
WHERE a.art_crt AND COALESCE(s.stock_total,0)/v.vdp < p.prv_dte
ORDER BY a.art_cd

WITH p AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_crt, a.art_cst,
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.exi_qty) FROM exidet e WHERE e.exi_art = a.art_cd),0) AS stock,
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(v.vta_und) FROM vtadia v WHERE v.vta_art = a.art_cd AND v.vta_fch BETWEEN (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) FROM vtadia) - 89 AND (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) FROM vtadia)),0)/90.0 AS d90
  FROM artmst a
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ocpcab o WHERE o.ocp_art = a.art_cd AND o.ocp_sts IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL','APPROVED'))
), q AS (
  SELECT art_cd, art_cst, stock, art_ptr, art_crt,
    CEIL(d90 * CASE WHEN art_crt THEN 45 ELSE 30 END) AS qty
  FROM (SELECT p.*, a.art_ptr FROM p JOIN artmst a ON a.art_cd = p.art_cd) x
  WHERE stock < art_ptr
), m AS (
  SELECT qty * art_cst AS monto FROM q
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN monto < 50000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comprador,
  SUM(CASE WHEN monto >= 50000 AND monto <= 250000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gerente,
  SUM(CASE WHEN monto > 250000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS director,
  COUNT(*) AS total
FROM m

WITH corte AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
ventas AS (
  SELECT v.vta_art, SUM(v.vta_und) AS u30
  FROM vtadia v, corte c
  WHERE v.vta_fch BETWEEN c.f - INTERVAL '29 day' AND c.f
  GROUP BY v.vta_art
),
stock AS (
  SELECT exi_art, SUM(exi_qty) AS stock_total FROM exidet GROUP BY exi_art
)
SELECT a.art_cd AS sku, a.art_crt, p.prv_dte, COALESCE(s.stock_total,0) AS stock,
       ve.u30, (ve.u30/30.0) AS venta_diaria,
       COALESCE(s.stock_total,0) / (ve.u30/30.0) AS cobertura_dias
FROM artmst a
JOIN prvmst p ON p.prv_id = a.art_prv
JOIN ventas ve ON ve.vta_art = a.art_cd
LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.exi_art = a.art_cd
WHERE a.art_crt = true AND ve.u30 > 0
  AND COALESCE(s.stock_total,0) / (ve.u30/30.0) < p.prv_dte
ORDER BY a.art_cd

WITH corte AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
stock AS (SELECT a.art_cd, COALESCE(SUM(e.exi_qty),0) AS tot FROM artmst a LEFT JOIN exidet e ON e.exi_art = a.art_cd GROUP BY a.art_cd),
dem AS (SELECT v.vta_art, SUM(v.vta_und) AS u FROM vtadia v, corte c WHERE v.vta_fch > c.f - 90 AND v.vta_fch <= c.f GROUP BY v.vta_art),
prop AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_crt, a.art_cst,
    CEIL(COALESCE(d.u,0) / 90.0 * CASE WHEN a.art_crt THEN 45 ELSE 30 END) AS qty
  FROM artmst a JOIN stock s ON s.art_cd = a.art_cd
  LEFT JOIN dem d ON d.vta_art = a.art_cd
  WHERE s.tot < a.art_ptr
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ocpcab o WHERE o.ocp_art = a.art_cd AND o.ocp_sts IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL','APPROVED'))
),
amt AS (SELECT art_cd, qty * art_cst AS monto FROM prop)
SELECT CASE WHEN monto < 50000 THEN 'comprador' WHEN monto <= 250000 THEN 'gerente' ELSE 'director' END AS aprobador,
       COUNT(*) AS n
FROM amt GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

argumentos.respuesta: La base no define un criterio único de "mejor proveedor". ¿Cómo quieres medirlo? Opciones que sí puedo calcular con los datos disponibles: (1) menor tiempo de entrega pactado (prvmst.prv_dte); (2) mayor proporción de órdenes de compra aprobadas (ocpcab.ocp_sts = 'APPROVED' frente al total de órdenes por proveedor vía artmst.art_prv); (3) mayor número de SKUs suministrados; (4) menor costo unitario promedio de sus artículos (artmst.art_cst). Nota: no hay datos de precios, calidad ni entregas reales (fechas de recepción), así que no puedo medir cumplimiento de entrega ni calidad.

argumentos.respuesta: No puedo calcular el margen de utilidad por SKU con los datos disponibles. El margen requiere el precio de venta de cada artículo, y la base no contiene ese dato. La tabla artmst solo tiene el costo unitario (art_cst, en pesos mexicanos), y vtadia solo registra unidades vendidas por día (vta_und), sin importes ni precios. Calcular un margen con otras columnas, como el costo o las unidades, daría un resultado falso. Para hacerlo se necesita una fuente de precios de venta por SKU (por ejemplo, una lista de precios o ventas con importe). Con esa fuente, el margen sería (precio - art_cst) / precio por SKU.

evidencia.extracto: artmst contiene art_cst (costo unitario en MXN) pero no existe columna de precio de venta; vtadia contiene solo vta_und (unidades vendidas).

supuestos: Se considera que el margen requiere precio de venta, que no existe en la base.
No se aproximó el margen con el costo ni con unidades vendidas.
